choices.content: At least 1 of the balls drawn is white.
At least 1 of the balls drawn is yellow.

question.prompt: An opaque bag contains 3 white balls and 2 yellow balls, identical except for color. Draw 3 balls at once. Which of the following is a certain event?

solutions.explanation: There are only 2 yellow balls, so drawing 3 balls must include at least 1 white ball. Thus, B is certain to occur; A and C may or may not occur, and D is impossible.
solutions.title: Using the limit on yellow balls
